title: The best Sacromonte area and caves tour with Nacho!
text: Get your walking shoes ready, this was a fantastic private tour!  Our guide, Nacho, was very pleasant and knowledgable. He even provided information of where to purchase baskets that we saw in the caves. This is the tour to take to gain knowledge about the Sacromonte area and caves.
author: 311demir

title: Albaicin and Caves of Sacromonte with Pedro
text: Pedro, our guide, was outstanding. Before the tour started he took us through a little history of Spain and Granada. We then headed off towards the caves of Sacromonte. On the way he took us through the Albaicin neighbourhood and then up to the cave homes. He was very knowledgeable about the neighbourhoods, the homes and also about the people. We thoroughly enjoyed our time with Pedro. A great guide and a lovely person.
author: Voyager33188286847
